title: Signups grind to a halt
description: The signup API hashes every password and stores it while the caller waits. Keep signups answering when the traffic climbs.
stack: Request generator, HTTP load balancer, instance group, Queue (SQS), Function (Lambda), Table (DynamoDB)
instructions: Signup API hashes every signup and writes it to the table before it answers. Signup Balancer spreads the traffic over however many instances it is set to run.
Put a queue and a function behind it, so the API hands the signup over and answers while the function does the hashing and the write. Connect the table to the function rather than to the API.

events.text: Signups climb to four a second

goals.title: Put a queue and a function behind the API
Store the hashed password from the function
At least 15 signups are answered every 5 seconds
Signups are answered in under 100 ms on average
goals.hint: More instances share the signups out between them, so the traffic keeps being answered. They do not make one signup any faster, which is what this goal asks for.

goals.title: Leave the queue drained at the end
goals.hint: The queue's gauge is its backlog. If it climbs instead of staying flat, whatever is reading the queue is not keeping up or is failing part way, and that node's Logs tab says which.
